Data vendored from the SMARTS benchmark dataset provided by the Center for Bioinformatics (ZBH), University of Hamburg.

Files:
- `brics-smarts.tar.gz`, `daylight-smarts.tar.gz`, `hann-smarts.tar.gz`, `olah-smarts.tar.gz`, `pains-smarts.tar.gz`, `walters-smarts.tar.gz`: various extracted SMARTS patterns from the literature.
- `smarts-benchmark-v2.0.zip`: the benchmark distribution version 2.0.
- `smarts-benchmark-v2.0/`: unpacked benchmark distribution directory.

Attribution and licensing:
- Source dataset: `https://www.zbh.uni-hamburg.de/en/forschung/amd/datasets/smarts-dataset.html`
- Publication: Ehrlich, H.-C. & Rarey, M. "Systematic benchmark of substructure search in molecular graphs - From Ullmann to VF2". J Cheminform 4, 13 (2012). `https://doi.org/10.1186/1758-2946-4-13`
